marks.gloss_en: דתניא: R' Meir lets the buyer of Kutim wine drink at once on the strength of a future separation; R' Yehuda, R' Yosei and R' Shimon forbid -- the baraita adduced for Abaye's mapping (kind tanya_kevatei: no kind names a bare דתניא)
one who buys wine from the Kutim says: two log I will separate are teruma, ten first tithe, nine second tithe; he redeems [the second tithe] and drinks at once -- R' Meir
זמנין דמוקים בפחות משלשה סמוך לסכך, וכיון דמייתא כווצא ולאו אדעתיה -- sometimes it is set within three [tefachim] of the sekhakh, and once dead it shrinks and he does not notice
ורמינן עלה: הרי זה גיטיך שעה אחת קודם מיתתי -- אסורה לאכול בתרומה מיד -- here we DO fear his death
[a kohen who says] 'this is your get an hour before my death' -- she is forbidden to eat teruma at once
לא קשיא: הא רבי מאיר דלא חייש למיתה, הא רבי יהודה דחייש למיתה (= p_abaye_kayam_rm, p_abaye_mitati_ry)
Abaye: the presumption-of-life mishnah is R' Meir's

ומי אמר אביי רבי מאיר חייש למיתה ורבי יהודה לא חייש? -- yet Abaye himself resolved the Gittin mishnayot by saying R' Meir does NOT fear death and R' Yehuda does (kind svara under protest: no kind for an amoraic-memra contradiction)
an Israelite woman married to a kohen whose husband went overseas eats teruma, on the presumption that he is alive
